home.title: Medical-Grade LED Light Therapy At Home by Omnilux
home.description: FDA-cleared LED light therapy backed by 40+ studies helping you achieve healthier, more radiant skin.
home.fit: **Device-led, not topical.** Omnilux sells LED masks at £348, with a smaller topical skincare line alongside. Beauty category and highly demo-able on video, but the creative job is device demonstration and results-over-time, not texture/application. Price point means a considered purchase, so UGC needs proof and authority rather than impulse.
